scope: Revision responding to the supplied independent referee report on A-v54: precise prior-work comparison, a standalone basepoint-free Lie lemma, a general disconnected-centre lifting obstruction, geometry-to-quantization proof order and uniform ambient A / quotient B notation. Existing principal theorem statements and proof content are preserved. Current proof reading, exact calculations, source checks, typesetting, visual inspection and remote persistence are recorded separately.

proof_chains_read: Euler/Koszul representation, divergence and Hessian condition
quadratic Lie lemma, all-dimensional Jacobian-block normal form, projective rank, leaves and degeneracy geometry
Bondal lower bounds via joins
universal mixed Hesse centre, classical Casimir kernel, universal rank and Cramer centre
Bertini splitting, PBW, Koszul/AS-regular ambient and central AS-Gorenstein quotient
fixed and relative Poisson stacks, Fermat component theorem, nonelliptic fixed components
quadratic envelope, polarized section algebra, conditional even-Veronese and derived reconstruction

Low-twist differential-form vanishing on smooth complete intersections via the punctured cone, conormal resolution and Euler contraction; this is a self-contained proof of a known vanishing statement.
Split cubic fourfolds: normal join divisor, reduced Poisson zero scheme, distinct singular scheme, local Pfaffian and modular field, pure ellipticity and generic-rank-four classification.
Nonconnected elliptic double curves: ambient cubic lifting obstruction, H^1(I_C)=C and H^1(I_C^2)=C, compared specifically with Pym arXiv:1507.05668v1.

Constant-rank divided-commutator kernel, actual-centre distinction under base change, affine Cramer transitions, global even central lift on a coefficient-dependent principal open containing the entire zero section.

Hesse example of different degree-three central ideals under the ambient identity; coordinate covariance, equivariant complement-line selection on the stated opens, and its remaining full-moduli scope.

Affine reductive equivariant lifting: invariant principal neighborhoods of a stable closed subscheme, lifting invariant sections with character twists, and splitting equivariant vector-bundle exact sequences.
All smooth full cubics: a G_0-invariant even good open containing the whole zero section and a G_0-covariant regular central lift whose image generates the central quotient line.
Smooth ternary restriction: a regular equivariant left inverse to directional differentiation, the centring law B_f_prime=(M B_f-C)N^-1, and the full parabolic block-group central lift.
The incompatibility, in general, of fixing pure-central coefficients with all central translations; the Fermat Weyl-symbol obstruction does not assert nonexistence of equivariant lifts.
Fiberwise central regularity, locally split degreewise multiplication, flat central quotient families and AS-Gorenstein invariants; t=eta*h fixes the deformation parameter under group action.

Reduced rank-two Poisson stratum via a nonzero decomposable-trivector incidence and a parabolic associated bundle; the central scalar gerbe and its character splitting when gcd(m,3)=1. For m=2 the base has dimension 17, without a claim about the fixed-nonzero-h image in noncommutative algebra moduli.
Split-fourfold obstruction: 0->I_C^2->I_C^3(3)->i_*J_C^3(3)->0 and the nonzero connecting class delta(g|X) generating H^1(I_C^2)=C.

Research notes: multi-block central-kernel projectivization, regularity using one active filtration and R-freeness, group-equivariant tautological quotients, classical-line dilatation and its restriction to h-regular test bases; the obstruction to a global retraction depending only on a noncone ternary cubic.
material_corrections: The relative forgetful scheme morphism is affine of finite type, not a closed immersion into the base.
Relative rank strata use the simultaneous scalar action (F,P)->(aF,a^-1 P) and reduced structures.
The threefold derived-recovery corollary explicitly assumes left/right noetherian B over C.
Ambient PBW alone does not imply S-freeness of the central quotient; regular highest active symbol is a sufficient condition, and B/(u^3) demonstrates the obstruction.

The semisimple kernel calculation is attributed precisely to Derdzinski--Gal Theorem B; radical elimination from smoothness remains a separate argument. Bondal section 4 supplies the earlier divergence-free homogeneous lift.

Pym arXiv v1 Theorem 1.3 / Proposition 5.7 are contradicted by the proved split cubic fourfold example. The disconnected-centre failure of Lemma 5.5 is exhibited explicitly; no assertion is made about an unverified published or corrected text.
The divided-commutator kernel commutes with arbitrary base change on the constant-rank open, whereas the ordinary centre can enlarge at h-torsion or at h=0.
Two normalized central lifts have transition Omega_j=a_ij Omega_i+c_ij; equality of their classical limits does not force a_ij=1 or equality of their central ideals.
The fixed-coordinate coefficient-family existence theorem does not assert a coefficient-independent parameter open or equivariant descent to the full Poisson moduli stack.

Uncorrected scalar-weight equivariance gives a gerbe family. When gcd(m,3)=1, the character theta=(det N)^r lambda^s with mr-3s=1 removes degree weights, giving actual graded-algebra descent to the stated reduced Poisson stratum open.
The abstract, introduction and ambient-recovery discussion distinguish the 17-dimensional reduced Poisson base from the unproved dimension of the fixed-nonzero-h noncommutative moduli image.

All-group equivariance does not retain the pure-central-coefficient gauge. The singular or zero ternary restriction and changes of multi-block decomposition or pure-central allocation remain separate questions.

Pointwise existence of a non-scalar central element is explicitly credited to Etingof--Ginzburg. Mixed quadratic coefficients by themselves are not claimed as new: for invertible Hesse t they can be translated to the existing presentation.

The general lifting obstruction is independent of any literature-error claim and is C^{pi_0(C)}/C; connectedness gives vanishing, while disconnectedness alone does not assert that every section has a nonzero obstruction.
The ambient recovery appendix uses A for the ambient algebra and B for its central quotient, consistently with the quantization part.

exact_computations.result: Smoothness of one explicit two-block cubic, 56 Jacobi and 56 Euler-wedge identities over exact coefficients.
Both saved integer certificates and the direct Schouten linearization: rank 33 in each of the nodal and cuspidal examples; determinants +8916100448256 and -4565043429507072.
All eight rows n=3,...,10: space/fixed-stack/relative-stack component counts.
339 weighted free words, 162 relation multiples, rank 144 at h=0 and over Q(h,t); three central commutators vanish with six independent mixed coefficients.
20 independent coefficients, 125 word/order coefficients for each of x,y,z; finite jet only.
Smooth total cubic with zero ternary restriction: exact rank 45 of a 378x56 matrix, kernel dimension 11.

Two monic Diamond systems and overlaps; six universal central commutators; h=0 limits; potential syzygies; denominator scopes; two negative controls; 17-term Fermat certificate. Recalculated result exactly matches the saved JSON without --write.

One split Fermat example over QQ: 20 ambient Jacobi triples and Casimir identity; all 10 projective brackets and 10 Jacobi triples; implicit-chart derivations and four Jacobi triples; Pfaffian/determinant, modular field and independent logarithmic-Pfaffian formula. This is a finite example, not the general smooth-f,g proof.

Fermat active cubic with all 25 mixed coefficients independent over QQ; two explicit rational block coordinate changes, of positive and negative active determinant. Checks the left inverse, extraction of B_f_prime=(M B_f-C)N^-1, covariance of the centred cubic, and all three Jacobian brackets with t_prime=lambda*det(M)*t. This is finite in the coordinate changes, not a computational proof of Reynolds existence or full-group equivariance.

Exact identity over the rational function field with independent Hesse and mixed coefficients: the translated cubic including its constant term and all three free-word quadratic relations agree with the stated Etingof--Ginzburg presentation. This does not prove centrality or PBW flatness.

remaining_limits: The Pym comparison is restricted to checked arXiv:1507.05668v1. Published metadata, the accepted-manuscript repository record and ordinary public access routes were checked, but published/accepted full text was not obtained; no claim is made about an unverified correction or its absence.

Brueckmann original proofs (1976 Satz 3 / 1977 Satz 6) were not obtained; Fu--Hwang Lemma 4.1 and its attribution were verified. The needed low-twist vanishing is proved self-containedly in the manuscript, so these unavailable proofs are no longer a mathematical dependency of that criterion.

Originality of the all-dimensional normal form, relative component theorem and full quantization combination is not exhaustively established. Bondal, Derdzinski--Gal, Reynolds averaging, projective bundles and character corrections are separated from the present application.

Full block-group equivariance when the ternary restriction is singular or zero, and compatibility under changes of multi-block decomposition and pure-central allocation, remain unresolved. The multi-block note retains the display data and the choice of a central line.

For gcd(m,3)=1, descent is proved on a zero-section-containing open over the stated reduced rank-two Poisson stratum. If 3 divides m, the given group has no character of scalar weight one; this does not prove nonneutrality of the gerbe or nonexistence of another descent method.
For cubic threefolds, 17 is the dimension of the reduced Poisson base. Generic finiteness or a 17-dimensional image for the abstract noncommutative algebras at fixed nonzero h is not proved.
Quantization over the full Poisson moduli stack, qgr smoothness for all closed parameters and relative residual equivalence through the commutative special point are not claimed.

Two exact computations were executed for A-v55: the new universal Hesse translation verifier and the existing split Fermat fourfold verifier. Eight earlier computation results were retained without rerun, with current script and certificate hashes checked. Symbolic identities, finite examples, mathematical proof reading and formal proof verification have different scopes.
